thread:
Maya: Hey folks - after the canary we see traces from service-x in Jaeger but only the root span. DB/grpc child spans missing. Anyone seen this? link: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/abcdef123
Devin: Could be sampling or instrumentation. Which OpenTelemetry SDK & auto-instrumentation are you using? Are we sending OTLP/HTTP or gRPC?
Maya: using python 1.18.0 with opentelemetry-instrumentation, exporter OTLP/HTTP to collector at otel-collector:4318. No sampler overrides in app config.
Sam: Did the collector change config in the deploy? We moved to batch processor v2 last week. Collector sometimes drops children if resource attrs mismatch. Check collector logs: `kubectl logs deploy/otel-collector -n observability` and `kubectl logs deploy/otel-collector -c otlp-receiver`
Devin: Also check env var `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER` and `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG`. If it got set to `traceidratio` with 0.0 it's effectively dropping everything. If using `parentbased`, child spans may be dropped if parent sampling decision was off.
Maya: hmm, sampler is `parentbased_traceidratio` with arg `0.01` — but we expect children to exist for sampled traces. Strange.
Alice: Another gotcha: instrumentations that don't activate context properly will create spans that aren't attached as children. Any recent lib upgrades? e.g., grpc or contextvar changes?
Maya: We bumped grpc from 1.54->1.58 in that PR. I'll try rolling that back in canary.
deploy-bot: Deployment `service-x-canary` rolled back to revision r234 (triggered by @Maya)
Sam: Also check collector metrics: `otel_collector_receiver_queued_spans_total` and `otel_collector_exporter_failed_spans_total`. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/observability/otel-collector - look at `otel_receiver_dropped_spans` and `otel_exporter_errors`
Devin: If rollback doesn't help, run with `OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG` and capture a short trace export snippet. Example command to reproduce locally:
```
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG python service_x/main.py --local-debug
```
Maya: will try that now. I'll post logs if I still see only root spans. Thanks!
Devin: If you can grab a raw OTLP payload we can inspect span.parentSpanId / traceFlags to see sampling decisions.
Maya: will follow up in this thread after tests. :thumbsup:
